title: A1 Whip Adapters
description:
A1 Whip Adapters
These glass whip adapters are all made to a high standard. You will find the joints to be accurate and ground to smooth finish which will allow for smooth connection to other glass assuming the other glass you are connecting to is also of a good quality.
Important Dimension:
Outside diameter of the glass tube that connects to the whip is approximately 10mm
Versions
14mm Male
14mm Female
18mm Male
18mm Female
Included
1 X Glass Whip Adapter (Please choose type)
